items.title: The scouting report on Matas Buzelis was to be physical.
items.author: Drew
items.body_excerpt:
The scouting report on Matas Buzelis was to be physical.

He apparently took note.

On Cousins, Buzelis told Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady he added about 12 pounds this offseason after hiring a chef.

“I've been driving and hitting dudes, bumping, stuff like that. Just everything more physical…”
